services.name: Other Event Rentals
services.desc: WEDDINGS at Newell Pioneer Village - We offer the flexibility to fit your wedding requests and needs, creating an event you and your guests will treasure for a lifetime! Weddings and receptions in the gardens are available for up to 200 guests. Small weddings inside the museums and Rebecca’s Tea Porch are available for up to 40 guests year-round. The REBECCA’S TEA PORCH overlooks historic Champoeg State Park and provides a bright, relaxing and professional space for your meeting or event. This space is excellent for groups up to 40 guests. services.name: Pioneer Mothers Memorial Cabin
services.desc: Originally built on the banks of the Willamette River in what is now Champoeg Heritage State Park in 1929, this cabin stands as a museum and memorial dedicated to the many Pioneer Women that braved the Oregon Trail. The cabin opened to the public in 1931 by the Oregon State Society Daughters of the American Revolution
